body.name: NuT
body.def: For \(T\ge T_0\) with \(u_{\mathrm p}(T)\ge u_0\), put \(\delta_T=\Delta(u_{\mathrm p}(T))\) and \(q_T=q(u_{\mathrm p}(T))\). For every integer \(j\) such that \(j\delta_T\in[0,T]\) and the level-\(u_{\mathrm p}(T)\) translate of \(A_u\) occurs at \(j\delta_T\), let \(r_T(j)=\inf\{r>j:D((r+\ell)\delta_T)\le u_{\mathrm p}(T)\text{ for }\ell=0,\ldots,q_T-1\}\). If \(r_T(j)<\infty\), then \(\mathcal N_T\) puts one point at \(\bigl(j\delta_T/T,\{\max_{j\le k<r_T(j)}D(k\delta_T)-b(T)\}/a(T)\bigr)\); if \(r_T(j)=\infty\), that root contributes no point. Thus the mark is the maximum of the forward runs-declustered pilot cluster, not the value at its first root.
